declare void @throw_exception()

declare i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

declare ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr)

declare void @__cxa_end_catch()

define void @test1() personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  invoke void @throw_exception()
          to label %try.cont unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          catch ptr null
  %1 = extractvalue { ptr, i32 } %0, 0
  %2 = tail call ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr %1)
  tail call void @__cxa_end_catch()
  br label %try.cont

try.cont:                                         ; preds = %lpad, %entry
  ret void
}

define <2 x i32> @test_pasubu_w(<2 x i32> %a, <2 x i32> %b) {
  %a_ext = zext <2 x i32> %a to <2 x i64>
  %b_ext = zext <2 x i32> %b to <2 x i64>
  %sub = sub <2 x i64> %a_ext, %b_ext
  %res = lshr <2 x i64> %sub, splat (i64 1)
  %res_trunc = trunc <2 x i64> %res to <2 x i32>
  ret <2 x i32> %res_trunc
}

  %phi = phi <vscale x 4 x i1> [ zeroinitializer, %entry ], [ %rec, %loop ]
  %avl = sub i64 %n, %iv
  %evl = call i32 @llvm.experimental.get.vector.length.i64(i64 %avl, i32 4, i1 true)

  %x = call <vscale x 4 x i32> @llvm.vp.load.nxv4i32.p0(ptr %gep, <vscale x 4 x i1> splat (i1 true), i32 %evl)

  %evl.zext = zext i32 %evl to i64
  %iv.next = add i64 %iv, %evl.zext

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop

  ret i1 %res
}

define i16 @add_ext_i16(<16 x i8> %a, <16 x i8> %b) {
  %ae = zext <16 x i8> %a to <16 x i16>
  %be = zext <16 x i8> %b to <16 x i16>
  %r1 = call i16 @llvm.vector.reduce.add.v16i16(<16 x i16> %ae)
  %r2 = call i16 @llvm.vector.reduce.add.v16i16(<16 x i16> %be)
  %r = add i16 %r1, %r2

@G.2 = external global <8 x i8>

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @lshr_32bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %LGV = load <8 x i8>, ptr @G.2, align 8
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %wordOff = load i256, ptr %wordOff.ptr, align 1
  %B = ashr <8 x i8> zeroinitializer, %LGV
  %bitOff = shl i256 %wordOff, 5
  %res = lshr i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store <8 x i8> %B, ptr poison, align 8
  ret void
}

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @shl_32bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %wordOff = load i256, ptr %wordOff.ptr, align 1
  %B = ashr <8 x i8> splat (i8 16), splat (i8 -1)
  %bitOff = shl i256 %wordOff, 5
  %res = shl i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store <8 x i8> %B, ptr poison, align 8
  ret void
}

@var = external global [32 x i64]
@G = external global i1

define void @foo() {
  %A = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 poison, ptr %A, align 1
  %C = icmp eq i32 -2147483648, 42
  %LGV = load i1, ptr @G, align 1
  %1 = load volatile [32 x i64], ptr @var, align 4
  store i1 %C, ptr %A, align 1
  br i1 %LGV, label %T, label %F

BB:                                               ; preds = %F
  store volatile [32 x i64] %1, ptr @var, align 4
  ret void

T:                                                ; preds = %0
  ret void

F:                                                ; preds = %0
  %G = getelementptr i8, ptr %A, i1 %C
  store ptr %G, ptr %A, align 8
  br label %BB
}

@var = external global [30 x i64]
@G = external global i1

define graalcc void @keep_live() {
  %A = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 poison, ptr %A, align 1
  %C = icmp eq i32 -2147483648, 42
  %LGV = load i1, ptr @G, align 1
  %val = load volatile [30 x i64], ptr @var, align 4
  store i1 %C, ptr %A, align 1
  br i1 %LGV, label %T, label %F

BB:                                               ; preds = %F
  store volatile [30 x i64] %val, ptr @var, align 4
  ret void

T:                                                ; preds = %0
  ret void

F:                                                ; preds = %0
  %G = getelementptr i8, ptr %A, i1 %C
  store ptr %G, ptr %A, align 8
  br label %BB
}
